alerts.title: Renal Function Monitoring
alerts.message: Guidelines recommend monitoring creatinine (eGFR) at 3 months, 6 months, and then 6-12 monthly for patients on TDF. Patient's latest creatinine is 112 umol/L, which is within normal limits. However, regular monitoring is still necessary, especially in high-risk patients with co-existent hypertension.
